arxiv-2103-05808.title: Large-scale holographic particle 3D imaging with the beam propagation model Journal: oe
arxiv-2103-05808.creator: Hao Wang, \authormark 1 Waleed Tahir \authormark 1, Jiabei Zhu, \authormark 1, and Lei Tian \authormark 1,*
arxiv-2103-05808.description: Abstract {abstract*} We develop a novel algorithm for large-scale holographic reconstruction of 3D particle fields. Our method is based on a multiple-scattering beam propagation method (BPM) combined with sparse regularization that enables recovering dense 3D particles of high refractive index contrast from a single hologram.

arxiv-2104-04178.title: Towards On-Demand Heralded Single-Photon Sources via Photon Blockade
arxiv-2104-04178.creator: Jiangshan Tang, Lei Tang, Haodong Wu, Yang Wu, Hui Sun, Han Zhang, Tao Li, Yanqing Lu (陆延青), Min Xiao, Keyu Xia (夏可宇)
arxiv-2104-04178.description: Abstract Spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in a laser pumped optical nonlinear medium can produce heralded single photons with a high purity but a very low yield. Improving the yield by increasing the pump power in SPDC inevitably reduces the purity due to excitation of multi-photon events.

arxiv-2109-06807.title: A Temporal Variational Model for Story Generation
arxiv-2109-06807.creator: David Wilmot, Frank Keller
arxiv-2109-06807.description: Abstract Recent language models can generate interesting and grammatically correct text in story generation but often lack plot development and long-term coherence. This paper experiments with a latent vector planning approach based on a TD-VAE (Temporal Difference Variational Autoencoder), using the model for conditioning and reranking for text generation. The results demonstrate strong performance in automatic cloze and swapping evaluations.

arxiv-2111-13033.title: arXiv:2111.nnnn
arxiv-2111-13033.description: Abstract The information horizon entropy for quantum dot and a symmetrical bath Harvendra Singh Theory Division, Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics (HBNI) 1/AF Bidhannagar, Kolkata 700064, India E-mail: h.singh [AT] saha.ac.in DRAFT : August 9, 2026 Abstract We study the entropy of quantum-dot system in contact with a symmetrical CFT bath living on the boundary of pure AdS3 black hole.

arxiv-2209-01782.title: “Is your explanation stable?”: A Robustness Evaluation Framework for Feature Attribution Conference: Proceedings of the 2022 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security; November 7–11, 2022; Los Angeles, CA, USA Proceedings of the 2022 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communic
arxiv-2209-01782.creator: Yuyou Gan, Yuhao Mao, Xuhong Zhang, Shouling Ji, Yuwen Pu, Meng Han, Jianwei Yin, Ting Wang
arxiv-2209-01782.description: Abstract . Neural networks have become increasingly popular. Nevertheless, understanding their decision process turns out to be complicated. One vital method to explain a models’ behavior is feature attribution, i . e ., attributing its decision to pivotal features. Although many algorithms are proposed, most of them aim to improve the faithfulness (fidelity) to the model.

arxiv-2304-14487.title: Continued fractions using a Laguerre digraph interpretation of the Foata–Zeilberger bijection and its variants
arxiv-2304-14487.creator: Bishal Deb, [3mm] Department of Mathematics, University College London, London WC1E 6BT, United Kingdom, [2mm] Sorbonne Université, Université Paris Cité, CNRS, Laboratoire de Probabilités Statistique et Modélisation, 75005 Paris, France[2mm] bishal@gonitsora.com
arxiv-2304-14487.description: Abstract In the combinatorial theory of continued fractions, the Foata–Zeilberger bijection and its variants have been extensively used to derive various continued fractions enumerating several (sometimes infinitely many) simultaneous statistics on permutations (combinatorial model for factorials) and D-permutations (combinatorial model for Genocchi and median Genocchi numbers).

arxiv-2309-09985.title: Molecular Conformation Generation via Shifting Scores
arxiv-2309-09985.creator: Zihan Zhou, Ruiying Liu, Chaolong Ying, Ruimao Zhang, Tianshu Yu
arxiv-2309-09985.description: Abstract Molecular conformation generation, a critical aspect of computational chemistry, involves producing the three-dimensional conformer geometry for a given molecule. Generating molecular conformation via diffusion requires learning to reverse a noising process. Diffusion on inter-atomic distances instead of conformation preserves SE(3)-equivalence and shows superior performance compared to alternative techniques, whereas related generative modelings are predominantly based upon heuristical assumptions.

arxiv-2411-11711.title: The Vol-Det conjecture for highly twisted alternating links Thanks: This work was supported by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of Russia (agreement no. 075-02-2024-1437).
arxiv-2411-11711.creator: Andrei Egorov, Andrei Vesnin
arxiv-2411-11711.description: Abstract . The Vol-Det Conjecture, formulated by Champanerkar, Kofman and Purcell, states that there exists a specific inequality connecting the hyperbolic volume of an alternating link and its determinant. Among the classes of links for which this conjecture holds are all alternating hyperbolic knots with at most 16 crossings, 2-bridge links, and links that are closures of 3-strand braids.

arxiv-2411-12000.title: ByteScience: Bridging Unstructured Scientific Literature and Structured Data with Auto Fine-tuned Large Language Model in Token Granularity
arxiv-2411-12000.creator: Tong Xie 1 5 , Hanzhi Zhang 2 , Shaozhou Wang 1 , Yuwei Wan 1 , Imran Razzak 3 , Chunyu Kit 4 , Wenjie Zhang 3 , and Bram Hoex 5
arxiv-2411-12000.description: Abstract Natural Language Processing (NLP) is widely used to supply summarization ability from long context to structured information. However, extracting structured knowledge from scientific text by NLP models remains a challenge because of its domain-specific nature to complex data preprocessing and the granularity of multi-layered device-level information.

arxiv-2503-21055.title: What Changed and What Could Have Changed? State-Change Counterfactuals for Procedure-Aware Video Representation Learning
arxiv-2503-21055.creator: Chi-Hsi Kung *, Frangil Ramirez *, Juhyung Ha, Yi-Ting Chen †, David J. Crandall †, Yi-Hsuan Tsai †
arxiv-2503-21055.description: Abstract Understanding a procedural activity requires modeling both how action steps transform the scene, and how evolving scene transformations can influence the sequence of action steps, even those that are accidental or erroneous. Existing work has studied procedure-aware video representations by modeling the temporal order of actions, but has not explicitly learned the state changes (scene transformations).

arxiv-2506-07511.title: Uniform Šoltés’ hypergraphs and Šoltés’ weighted graphs
arxiv-2506-07511.creator: Stijn Cambie, Ajay Tiwari
arxiv-2506-07511.description: Abstract A Šoltés’ hypergraph is a hypergraph for which the removal of any of its vertices does not change its total distance. We prove that every uniform Šoltés’ hypergraph has order at least 10 10 , there exist uniform Šoltés’ hypergraphs for almost every order or uniformity, and there exist a non-regular uniform Šoltés’ hypergraph.

arxiv-2507-14352.title: A Reproducibility Study of Product-side Fairness in Bundle Recommendation 715 Conference: Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems; September 22–26, 2025; Prague, Czech Republic Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys ’25), September 22–
arxiv-2507-14352.creator: Huy-Son Nguyen, Yuanna Liu, Masoud Mansoury, Mohammad Aliannejadi, Alan Hanjalic, Maarten de Rijke
arxiv-2507-14352.description: Abstract . Recommender systems are known to exhibit fairness issues, particularly on the product side, where products and their associated suppliers receive unequal exposure in recommended results. While this problem has been widely studied in traditional recommendation settings, its implications for bundle recommendation (BR) remain largely unexplored.

arxiv-2509-16608.title: Reverberation lags viewed in hard X-rays from an accreting stellar-mass black hole

arxiv-2509-16608.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bei You, Wei Yu, Adam Ingram, Barbara De Marco, Jin-Lu Qu, Zong-Hong Zhu, Andrea Santangelo, Sai-En Xu. Accreting black holes are thought to swallow matter in the form of a disk and a hot cloud of plasma that glows brightly in X-rays, known as the corona.

arxiv-2601-22569.title: Whispers of Wealth: Red-Teaming Google’s Agent Payments Protocol via Prompt Injection
arxiv-2601-22569.creator: Tanusree Debi, Wentian Zhu
arxiv-2601-22569.description: Abstract Large language model (LLM)–based agents are increasingly used to automate financial transactions, yet their reliance on contextual reasoning exposes payment systems to prompt-driven manipulation. The Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) aims to secure agent-led purchases through cryptographically verifiable mandates, but its practical robustness remains underexplored.

pmc-11602619.title: Comparative modeling reveals the molecular determinants of aneuploidy fitness cost in a wild yeast model
pmc-11602619.creator: Julie Rojas, James Hose, H Auguste Dutcher, Michael Place, John F Wolters, Chris Todd Hittinger, Audrey P Gasch
pmc-11602619.description: SummaryAlthough implicated as deleterious in many organisms, aneuploidy can underlie rapid phenotypic evolution. However, aneuploidy will be maintained only if the benefit outweighs the cost, which remains incompletely understood. To quantify this cost and the molecular determinants behind it, we generated a panel of chromosome duplications in Saccharomyces cerevisiae and applied comparative modeling and molecular validation to understand aneuploidy toxicity.

pmc-12427343.title: The Targeted Inhibition of Histone Lysine Demethylases as a Novel Promising Anti-Cancer Therapeutic Strategy—An Update on Recent Evidence
pmc-12427343.creator: Jarosław Paluszczak, Robert Kleszcz, Hongwu Chen
pmc-12427343.description: Simple SummaryThe dysregulation of epigenetic mechanisms is an important feature of cancer cells. Histone lysine demethylases affect the expression of many genes responsible for the regulation of cell survival, proliferation, motility, metabolism, or cell death. The inhibition of these proteins can significantly block the proliferation of cancer cells and the growth of tumors.

pmc-12604078.title: Photobiomodulation, Compared to Revascularisation, and Conservative Treatment—What Works for Healing Hard‐to‐Heal Arterial Leg Ulcers in Older Adults: A Quasi‐Experimental Study
pmc-12604078.creator: Marianne Degerman, Laura Corneliusson, Micael Öhman, Marcus Schmitt‐Egenolf, Bo Christer Bertilson, Åsa Audulv
pmc-12604078.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hard‐to‐heal arterial leg ulcers in older adults are a challenging and complex condition. In this quasi‐experimental study, three treatment approaches were compared. The purpose was to investigate (1) the healing time of arterial leg ulcers in older adults (≥ 70 years) who underwent photobiomodulation, revascularisation, or conservative treatment; (2) the importance of factors associated with impaired healing; and (3) ulcer recurrence after healing with photobiomodulation.

pmc-12749423.title: Influence of ApoE genotype on doxorubicin-induced cognitive impairment in juvenile rats
pmc-12749423.creator: Chadni Patel, Frank Diglio, Benjamin H Durham, Peter D Cole
pmc-12749423.description: Many pediatric cancer survivors experience chemotherapy-induced cognitive impairment (CICI), which negatively impacts their quality of life. However, while some patients develop CICI, others do not, suggesting that genetic variants may contribute to the development of CICI. The Apolipoprotein E (ApoE) E4 allele has been identified as a risk variant for CICI among pediatric cancer survivors.

pmc-12775095.title: Atherogenic index of plasma and cognitive impairment risk among hypertensive adults: evidence from a nationwide cohort study
pmc-12775095.creator: Weimin Bai, Bing Feng, Yaowen Li, Raoman Feng, Lijie Qin
pmc-12775095.description: BackgroundCognitive impairment is a major complication in individuals with hypertension. Emerging evidence suggests that metabolic abnormalities may contribute to its pathogenesis. This study examined the association between the atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) and risk of cognitive impairment in middle-aged and older adults with hypertension.
